\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs of feeling and conflict — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R183-first-pass-verbs-of-feeling-and-conflict}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a meeting and a kitchen.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to shake, to pull, to push, to throw, to taste
  \item to smell, to celebrate, to grind, to boil, to fry
  \item to weave, to hit, to fight, to be afraid, to shout
  \item to get tired, to bear, to remove, to move aside, to pass by
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To shake? (\textbf{\hi{हिलाना}}, \emph{hilānā}.) To pull? (\textbf{\hi{खींचना}}, \emph{khī̃cnā}.) To push? (\textbf{\hi{धकेलना}}, \emph{dhakelnā}.) To throw? (\textbf{\hi{फेंकना}}, \emph{phẽknā}.) To taste? (\textbf{\hi{चखना}}, \emph{cakhnā}.) To smell? (\textbf{\hi{सूँघना}}, \emph{sū̃ghnā}.) To celebrate? (\textbf{\hi{मनाना}}, \emph{manānā}.) To grind? (\textbf{\hi{पीसना}}, \emph{pīsnā}.) To boil? (\textbf{\hi{उबालना}}, \emph{ubālnā}.) To fry? (\textbf{\hi{तलना}}, \emph{talnā}.) To weave? (\textbf{\hi{बुनना}}, \emph{bunnā}.) To hit? (\textbf{\hi{मारना}}, \emph{mārnā}.) To fight? (\textbf{\hi{लड़ना}}, \emph{laṛnā}.) To be afraid? (\textbf{\hi{डरना}}, \emph{ḍarnā}.) To shout? (\textbf{\hi{चिल्लाना}}, \emph{cillānā}.) To get tired? (\textbf{\hi{थकना}}, \emph{thaknā}.) To bear? (\textbf{\hi{सहना}}, \emph{sahnā}.) To remove? (\textbf{\hi{हटाना}}, \emph{haṭānā}.) To move aside? (\textbf{\hi{हटना}}, \emph{haṭnā}.) To pass by? (\textbf{\hi{गुज़रना}}, \emph{guzarnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Health, travel and work — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R183-second-pass-health-travel-and-work}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for medicine and a patient.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item medicine, a patient, treatment, a journey, luggage
  \item a map, a way, a turn, a crossroads, a ship
  \item a boat, a seat, a salary, an owner, a labourer
  \item a factory, a shopkeeper, a customer, a meeting, a kitchen
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Medicine? (\textbf{\hi{दवा}}, \emph{davā}.) A patient? (\textbf{\hi{मरीज़}}, \emph{marīz}.) Treatment? (\textbf{\hi{इलाज}}, \emph{ilāj}.) A journey? (\textbf{\hi{यात्रा}}, \emph{yātrā}.) Luggage? (\textbf{\hi{सामान}}, \emph{sāmān}.) A map? (\textbf{\hi{नक़्शा}}, \emph{naqśā}.) A way? (\textbf{\hi{रास्ता}}, \emph{rāstā}.) A turn? (\textbf{\hi{मोड़}}, \emph{moṛ}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{\hi{चौराहा}}, \emph{caurāhā}.) A ship? (\textbf{\hi{जहाज़}}, \emph{jahāz}.) A boat? (\textbf{\hi{नाव}}, \emph{nāv}.) A seat? (\textbf{\hi{सीट}}, \emph{sīṭ}.) A salary? (\textbf{\hi{तनख़्वाह}}, \emph{tankhvāh}.) An owner? (\textbf{\hi{मालिक}}, \emph{mālik}.) A labourer? (\textbf{\hi{मज़दूर}}, \emph{mazdūr}.) A factory? (\textbf{\hi{कारख़ाना}}, \emph{kārkhānā}.) A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\hi{दुकानदार}}, \emph{dukāndār}.) A customer? (\textbf{\hi{ग्राहक}}, \emph{grāhak}.) A meeting? (\textbf{\hi{बैठक}}, \emph{baiṭhak}.) A kitchen? (\textbf{\hi{रसोई}}, \emph{rasoī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
